title.zh: 薄膜工程：厚度只是第一关
title.en: Thin-film engineering: thickness is only the first hurdle

subtitle.en: Uniformity, conformality, stress, interface and particles

body.zh: 1；表面预处理；去除有机物/氧化层；活化表面
body.en: 1 Surface pretreatment Remove organics / oxide and activate the surface

body.zh: 2；成核；物种到达表面；形成成核位点
body.en: 2 Nucleation Species reach the surface and form nucleation sites

body.zh: 3；薄膜生长；持续供给与反应；薄膜逐步生长
body.en: 3 Film growth Continuous supply and reaction grow the film progressively

body.zh: 4；Purge/；副产物排出；排出副产物与过量前驱体；准备下一步/稳定生长
body.en: 4 Purge / byproduct removal Remove byproducts and excess precursor to prepare the next step / stabilize growth

body.zh: 5；后处理与；膜质检查；退火/致密化（可选）；膜质与厚度检查
body.en: 5 Post-treatment and film-quality inspection Anneal / densify (optional) Inspect film quality and thickness

body.zh: PVD：物理输运，方向性较明显；Target；溅射/蒸发等物理输运，直线性路径，；对深孔/高深宽比覆盖受限。
body.en: PVD: physical transport with stronger directionality Target Physical transport such as sputtering/evaporation follows line-of-sight paths, limiting coverage in deep holes and high-aspect-ratio features

body.zh: CVD：气相反应与表面成膜；气体扩散至表面，表面反应生成薄膜，；覆盖性优于PVD，受扩散与反应限制。
body.en: CVD: gas-phase reaction and surface film formation Gas diffuses to the surface and reacts to form a film; coverage is better than PVD, limited by diffusion and reaction

body.zh: ALD：表面自限反应，循环生长；前驱体A；前驱体B；交替脉冲与吹扫，表面自限反应，；原子层级生长，覆盖性最佳。
body.en: ALD: self-limiting surface reactions and cyclic growth Precursor A Precursor B Alternating pulses and purges create self-limiting surface reactions, atomic-scale layer growth and best coverage

body.zh: 理想的共形覆盖（高深宽比沟槽）；侧壁与底部厚度一致，无空隙、无缝隙覆盖。
body.en: Ideal conformal coverage (high-aspect-ratio trench) Equal sidewall and bottom thickness, without voids or seams

body.zh: 薄膜厚度均匀性（Wafer Map 示例）；Thickness (Å)；1200；1050；900；750；600；良好（±2%）；较差（±8%）
body.en: Film-thickness uniformity (wafer-map example) Thickness (Å) 1200 1050 900 750 600 Good (±2%) Poor (±8%)

body.zh: 五个核心指标；Thickness；Uniformity；Conformality；Stress；Interface
body.en: Five core metrics Thickness Uniformity Conformality Stress Interface

body.zh: 三组Trade-off；Temperature ↑：膜质可能改善；Thermal Budget ↑
body.en: Three trade-offs Temperature ↑: film quality may improve Thermal budget ↑

body.zh: Conformality ↑：复杂结构；覆盖改善；Throughput/成本压力
body.en: Conformality ↑: better coverage of complex structures Throughput / cost pressure

body.zh: Stress控制：；附着与翘曲之间平衡
body.en: Stress control: balance adhesion against warpage

body.zh: 常见失效；Pinhole；Seam；Void；Particle；Delamination；Thickness；Non-uniformity
body.en: Common failures Pinhole Seam Void Particle Delamination Thickness nonuniformity

body.zh: 方法边界；PVD、CVD与ALD机理；不同，不能用同一套；固定步骤和优缺点解；释所有薄膜。
body.en: Method boundaries PVD, CVD and ALD have different mechanisms, so a single set of fixed steps and advantages/disadvantages cannot explain every film

body.zh: 量测反馈：Thickness Map / Stress / Sheet R/ Composition / XSEM；Ellipsometer /；Reflectometry
body.en: Metrology feedback: thickness map / stress / sheet R / composition / XSEM Ellipsometer / reflectometry

body.zh: Wafer Curvature；（Stress）
body.en: Wafer curvature (stress)

body.zh: Four-Point Probe；（Sheet R）
body.en: Four-point probe (sheet R)

body.zh: Composition；（XPS/ EDS）；Counts （a.u.）；Energy (eV)
body.en: Composition (XPS / EDS) Counts (a.u.) Energy (eV)

body.zh: XSEM；（Interface / Thickness）；100nm
body.en: XSEM (interface / thickness) 100 nm

body.zh: 优化工艺与条件选择；（前驱体/功率/压力/；温度/时间/流量等）
body.en: Optimize process and condition selection (precursor / power / pressure / temperature / time / flow, etc.)

body.zh: 影响：；Etch Window；Interconnect R；Leakage；CMP；Reliability
body.en: Impact: Etch window Interconnect resistance Leakage CMP Reliability

body.zh: 材料类型（示例）；Dielectric（SiO₂ / SiN / HfO₂ / Al₂O₃ 等）；Metal（Cu/W/ Al/Co等）；Barrier（TaN /TiN 等）；Seed （Cu Seed / Ru Seed 等）/ Functional Film （a-Si/ SiGe / High-k/ Ferroelectric 等）；*非穷尽列举
body.en: Material types (examples) Dielectric (SiO₂ / SiN / HfO₂ / Al₂O₃, etc.) Metal (Cu / W / Al / Co, etc.) Barrier (TaN / TiN, etc.) Seed (Cu seed / Ru seed, etc.) / functional films (a-Si / SiGe / high-k / ferroelectric, etc.) *Non-exhaustive list

notes.zh: “CVD覆盖性优于PVD”“ALD覆盖性最佳”为原图的概括性表述，原图同时提示方法与材料边界；此处忠实保留，不扩展为所有条件的结论。
notes.en: The source broadly states better CVD coverage than PVD and best ALD coverage, while also noting method/material boundaries. These statements are retained without extending them to all conditions.
